values.note: 19 large, well-spaced sites in one loop, 4 of them pull-through. Maximum trailer length 30 ft; two vehicles per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/buffalo-pass-campground ('There are 19 large, well-spaced sites, with 4 pull-through options.'; 'Maximum two vehicles per site. Extra vehicle fee may apply. Maximum length trailer is 30 feet.'), read 2026-10-28

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/buffalo-pass-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 2026 season scheduled May 19 - November 18 ('Dates may change'); seasons of use mid-May to mid-November.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/buffalo-pass-campground ('Campground is scheduled to open for the 2026 season from May 19th to November 18th. Dates may change.'; Seasons of Use 'Mid-May to Mid-November'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Single and double sites $10/night; day use $10 per vehicle. Credit cards not accepted.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/buffalo-pass-campground ('Day Use: $10 per vehicle per day / Overnight Use: Single and Double Site: $10 per night / Credit cards not accepted.'; page last updated May 20, 2026), read 2026-10-28

note: Single loop in a ponderosa pine grove ringed by grass meadow at ~9,100 ft, just off CO-114 (27.6 mi west of Saguache, then 1.7 mi of gravel on FR 775). Sites 16-18 sit on a dead-end spur with no turnaround. A 32-ft fifth wheel has fit, per a review. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed 19 sites / 4 pull-throughs / 30-ft max trailer, vault toilets, no potable water, FCFS only, $10. Added the 2026 season dates (05-19..11-18) and a fee note; phone 719-655-2547 confirmed (Saguache RD). Note trimmed of field restatements.
